records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Ben,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Clearwater Group!
records.body:
Hi Ben,

Your workspace for Clearwater Group is ready to go. The single highest-leverage thing in week one is creating a real project rather than a test one -- it's what makes the first week actually useful.

I'm here if anything's unclear.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: New signup alert -- *Clearwater Group* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: Ben replied engaged and said setup is "on our list this week" [email:07b298ff]; first project already reached 2026-07-15, one day before as_of, showing momentum. But no invite sent and key milestone not reached with 8 days left, and he flags the team is slow to get set up.

draft.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ben,

Thanks for the update — totally understood that getting everyone set up takes a bit. Nice work getting your first project created; projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding a few real tasks there is the natural next step.

When you're ready to bring the team in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through either piece with you.

Best,
Nadia
